blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements released per operating system (OS) for Zscaler Endpoint DLP.

blocks.heading: Feature Available: Endpoint DLP 26.08.1.16 for Windows 26.08.1.16
Endpoint DLP 26.08.1.16 Windows Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.item: Expanded Device Control Support for Portable Devices, CD/DVD, and Floppy Disks
Device Control now supports portable devices such as smartphones and cameras, CD/DVD, and floppy disk channels.
This release also introduces support for selecting multiple devices and additional resources for managing device criteria.
To learn more, see About Device Control, Managing a Portable Device Rule, Managing a CD/DVD Rule, Managing a Floppy Disk Rule, and About Resources.
Support for Windows on ARM
Support for Windows on ARM is now available.
This is currently in Limited Availability and depends on the Zscaler Client Connector version 4.10.0.463 and later.
To learn more, see Step-by-Step Configuration Guide for Zscaler Endpoint DLP.
DLP Intent Visibility Into Suspicious User Behavior
Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Intent provides visibility into potential insider risk by identifying user behaviors that might indicate suspicious activity, including:
Abnormal behavior
Evasive actions
Data manipulation activities
To learn more, see About Indicators of Intent and Managing an Intent Rule.
Inbound Visibility for Sensitive Files Entering Endpoints
Gain visibility into sensitive files ingress to the endpoint when files containing one or more DLP engines introduced through:
Files downloaded from the web
Files copied locally from network shares
Files copied from removable storage
IDM Enhancements for DLP Engine Selection and Full-Folder Indexing
This release includes the following IDM improvements:
During IDM template creation, the full list of DLP engines is now available for selection.
At the endpoint, you can now index all files within a folder instead of being limited to up to 20 files.
To learn more, see Configuring Sensitive Information Settings.
Configuration Options for OCR, Exclusions, Scan Throttling, and Reporting
The following configuration options are added to the Configuration page:
OCR now supports PDFs and runs in real-time for all channels except Application File Access.
Exclude files and folders from continuous classification and application scans.
Pause scans based on an administrator-defined CPU threshold.
Exclude trusted applications from Endpoint DLP inspection.
Limit reporting to only matched DLP dictionaries and DLP engines based on triggered policies.
Exclude console applications from both Printing and Clipboard channels on Windows.
To learn more, see Configuring Endpoint Data Scan, Endpoint Settings, and Channels.

blocks.heading: Feature Available: Endpoint DLP 26.02.4.2 for Windows 26.02.4.2
Endpoint DLP 26.02.4.2 Windows Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.item: Fixes an issue with CPU and resource utilization to enhance overall endpoint performance.
Fixes a clipboard compatibility issue when CrowdStrike’s Extended User Mode Data (XUMD) is set to Aggressive mode.
Fixes an issue affecting the recognition of Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) files protected with Rights Management Services (RMS).

blocks.heading: Feature Available: Endpoint DLP 26.02.1.18 for Windows 26.02.1.18
Endpoint DLP 26.02.1.18 Windows Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.item: Support for Japanese predefined DLP dictionaries (i.e., Addresses (Japan), First Names (Japan), Full Names (Japan), Last Names (Japan)). To learn more, see Understanding Predefined DLP Dictionaries.

Fixes an issue where Zscaler Incident Receiver evidence files larger than the 25 MB size limit were not uploaded. Now, Endpoint DLP generates a placeholder file for evidence files that exceed the limit.
Fixes an issue where Application File Access rules were not being correctly enforced for the WhatsApp desktop application.

Fixes an issue where background clipboard actions (such as hovering over elements in Slack) caused excessive notification messages. Alerts are now limited to one per process for the same clipboard content.

blocks.heading: Feature Available: Endpoint DLP 26.02.0.21 for Windows 26.02.0.21
Endpoint DLP 26.02.0.21 Windows Enhancements and Fixes

blocks.item: Supports setting a network type (e.g., Trusted, Off-Trusted, VPN) for the Network Share, Printing, and Device Control channels when creating policy rules for Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP). Endpoints must be running Zscaler Client Connector version 4.8.600 or later (Windows) or version 4.7.1 or later (macOS) for policy rules to enforce the network type. To learn more, see Configuring Endpoint DLP Policy Rules, Managing a Removable Storage Rule, Managing a Printer Rule, and Managing a Nearby Sharing Rule.
To access this feature, contact your Zscaler Account team.

Supports using Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) ranges and regular expressions for advanced matching when creating or editing network shares for Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) resources. To learn more, see Adding DLP Resources and Editing DLP Resources.

Supports Exact Data Matching (EDM) for Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP), which provides protection for structured sensitive data. You can access Exact Data Matching (EDM) page from Analytics > Endpoint Data Scan > Sensitive Information. To learn more, see Understanding Exact Data Matching (EDM) and About Endpoint Data Scan Sensitive Information: Exact Data Matching.
To access this feature, contact your Zscaler Account team.

Supports Share Files Externally, providing a capability for Endpoint DLP that allows authorized users to securely share sensitive files with external partners by encrypting the data into a secure HTML format, ensuring that only verified recipients can access the content. You can access the Share Files Externally page from Analytics > Endpoint Data Scan > Sensitive Information. To learn more, see About Endpoint Data Scan Sensitive Information: Share Files Externally, Configuring Share File Externally Settings, and Understanding Share Files Externally.

Supports enhanced capabilities to block unauthorized file save operations on removable storage or network shares, including Microsoft Office applications. To learn more, see Configuring Endpoint Data Scan, Endpoint Settings, and Channels.

Supports completely excluding specific printers from Endpoint DLP and Device Control inspection, enforcement, and reporting by selecting disabled as the enforcement mode in the Exception Settings for Printers. To learn more, see Configuring Endpoint Data Scan, Endpoint Settings, and Channels.
Supports the inspection of Base64-encoded content for sensitive data. To learn more, see Configuring Endpoint DLP Policy Rules.
